description: Cancels a queued or running layout generation belonging to the specified board; use get_generation when only checking progress. A completed, failed or already cancelled job retains its terminal status. Cancellation cannot be undone; starting again requires a new job. It can update the saved board revision, so read get_board before further edits. A later job is unaffected.

boardRef.description: Private board reference. For a new board generate 32 random bytes, encode as unpadded base64url, and prepend egbr1_. Keep this same value for creation retries and every later board operation. Copy returned references unchanged. Keep it in this conversation or supported private execution state; never put it in logs or source files. A private board link may carry it in its fragment.

generationId.description: Layout generation ID returned by create_board, update_board or generate_layout for this same board. Use the exact job ID when polling or stopping it.

name: stop_generation
title: Stop generation
